items.title: Approve the Minutes of the July 22, 2025 Meeting
Reappoint Phoebe Ford as the District 4 Representative to the Community Advisory Committee
Allocate $14,340,000 in Prop L Funds, with Conditions, for Three Requests and Amend the Prop K Standard Grant Agreement for the Next Generation Sanchez Slow Street
Authorize an Additional Construction Allotment of $9,635,000; Approve a Contract Amendment with WMH Corporation

Adopt a Resolution Authorizing the Executive Director to Execute and Submit an Allocation Request to the Metropolitan Transportation Commission for $16,250,000 in Regional Measure 3 Bridge Toll Funds as the Implementing
Approve Programming of $1,374,000 in Senate Bill 1 Local Partnership Program Formulaic Funds to the Yerba Buena Island Multi-Use Pathway Segment 4 ? Treasure Island Road Improvements Project
Approve the Conceptual Safety-Focused Autonomous Vehicle Permitting Framework Report
